correctness.rationale: Exact rank-one information matrices have characteristic polynomials (z-1)^2(z-8) and z(z-4)(z-5). For t=exp(-1/mu), the full smoothed ranking is precisely sign of P(t)=(t-1)Q(t). Q has two Descartes sign changes and opposite exact signs at 1/2,3/5,9/10, yielding exactly two simple roots in (0,1) and complete all-mu classification. A direct ordered-eigenvalue integral proves strict softmin dominance in d<=2 whenever one alternative leads both minimum eigenvalue and trace. Script verify.py reproduces exact coefficients/signs and bisection; all universal steps are analytic.
